skill.name: amazon-asin-lookup-api-skill
skill.description: Retrieves structured Amazon product details for a supplied ASIN through the BrowserAct Amazon ASIN Lookup API template.
skill.summary: Look up Amazon product metadata, price, ratings, and details by ASIN.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally runs a bundled Python script that contacts BrowserAct APIs, reads BROWSERACT_API_KEY, and sends it as a bearer token. Most Markdown backtick and system reconnaissance alerts are false positives, but credential handling, chat-based key collection guidance, and automated extraction positioning remain material risks.

remediation.issue: API key may be requested in chat.
remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to provide BROWSERACT_API_KEY in chat. Require a local environment variable or approved secret store instead.

remediation.issue: The skill sends authenticated requests to BrowserAct.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the exact external service, transmitted data, and credential use before execution. Ask for user confirmation before the first network call.

remediation.issue: ASIN input is not validated before script execution.
remediation.suggestion: Validate ASIN values against the expected Amazon identifier format before running the script or sending requests.

remediation.issue: Marketing text frames captcha and IP restrictions as obstacles to avoid.
remediation.suggestion: Replace that language with compliance guidance and require users to confirm they have rights to collect the requested product data.

content.user_title: Look Up Amazon ASIN Product Data
content.value_statement: Amazon product research often requires current product details from a known ASIN. This skill uses BrowserAct to retrieve structured title, price, rating, brand, and description data.
actual_capabilities: Runs a local Python script for a supplied Amazon ASIN.
Uses the BrowserAct workflow API to start an ASIN lookup task.
Polls task status until the BrowserAct workflow finishes or times out.
Returns product fields such as title, price, rating, brand, URL, and description.
Reports invalid BrowserAct authorization errors to the user.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct API key before any lookup can run.
Depends on BrowserAct API availability and Amazon page accessibility.
Accepts one ASIN per script execution.
Does not verify legal rights or marketplace policy compliance for data collection.

use_cases.title: Enrich Product Catalogs
use_cases.description: Fill catalog records with Amazon title, brand, price, URL, rating, and descriptive fields from known ASINs.

use_cases.title: Check Competitive Prices
use_cases.description: Retrieve current Amazon pricing and rating signals for selected products before a pricing review.

use_cases.title: Validate Product Metadata
use_cases.description: Confirm that an ASIN resolves to the expected product, brand, and product page before publishing listings.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up One ASIN
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner lookup for a single product.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to look up ASIN B07TS6R1SF. Summarize the title, price, rating, brand, availability, and product URL.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Several ASINs
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate comparison using repeated single-ASIN lookups.
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up these ASINs one by one: ASIN_1, ASIN_2, and ASIN_3. Compare current price, brand, rating count, and product URL.

prompt_templates.title: Enrich Catalog Fields
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced catalog enrichment with missing-field review.
prompt_templates.prompt: For this ASIN list, enrich my catalog records with brand, description, special features, material, and product URL. Flag fields not returned.

prompt_templates.title: Monitor Product Changes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review against existing reference values.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run lookups for these monitored ASINs and compare the results with my provided baseline prices and ratings. Identify meaningful changes.

output_examples.output: Returns the product title, current price, original price if found, star rating, rating count, brand, product URL, and key features.

output_examples.input: Compare three ASINs for a catalog update.
output_examples.output: Provides a concise comparison of each product, including price, rating count, brand, URL, and missing fields that need manual review.

output_examples.input: Check whether my stored title and price are still current for this ASIN.
output_examples.output: Reports the latest returned title and price, then highlights differences from the values supplied by the user.

best_practices: Store BROWSERACT_API_KEY in an environment variable or approved secret manager.
Confirm that each ASIN is valid before running the lookup.
Review Amazon and BrowserAct usage terms before collecting product data.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or shared documents.
Do not run large unattended lookup batches without permission and rate controls.
Do not treat returned prices or availability as guaranteed real-time inventory data.

faq.question: What input does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs one Amazon ASIN and a configured BrowserAct API key.

faq.question: Where should I store the API key?
faq.answer: Store BROWSERACT_API_KEY in your local environment or an approved secret manager.

faq.question: Can it process many ASINs at once?
faq.answer: The included script accepts one ASIN per run. An agent can repeat the run for a small list.

faq.question: What product fields can it return?
faq.answer: It can return title, URL, brand, price fields, ratings, descriptions, features, material, style, and related attributes when available.

faq.question: Does it scrape Amazon directly from my machine?
faq.answer: No. The script sends the task to BrowserAct, then polls BrowserAct for status and results.

faq.question: Is the returned data always complete?
faq.answer: No. Returned fields depend on the product page, BrowserAct workflow result, and current availability of the source data.
